WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-17 11:30 to 2026-11-18 11:30 UTC

1. Action needed: decide or ratify; Urgency: the Door 3 question is what holds five PRs. Also waiting for your merge: srs#1033 to #1037 (gate:owner-merge, since 14 Nov).

No red gate reported by a run this cycle. Needs-input: srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, #728; srs-web#691.

5b. Awaiting ratification: the six proposed decisions in section 1 (oldest 21b6b4b7, 7+ weeks). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready and neither blocked nor needs-input: none (srs-rust 9 ready, of which #1638, #1637, #1636, #1635, #1496 blocked and #1495, #1164, #731, #728 need input; srs 2 ready, both blocked (#1027, #928); srs-vscode 0; srs-web 1, needs input (#691)). Top 3 in the Builder's order: none available. **Queue running dry: 0 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** Where new work could come from: the blocked items unblock when the Door 3 question (de6b88c5) and the srs#1033 to #1037 merges land, then the spec-to-implementation drift list. Waits on the owner: the six decisions, five Door 3 merges, the acknowledgement that resumes the group. Local priorities: none set. Fed by the analyst: not re-read this cycle.

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle.

7. What we learned: the pause is holding as designed and costs nothing while nothing can be built; the real hold is one unanswered owner question (de6b88c5), which blocks the srs PRs and the srs-rust work behind them. Measurement I1 (d6ddb294-b128-4eaf-a61e-1da6c74df570): 0 of 0 merged PRs in the window (it opens at the 11:30 cycleStart, so it is empty at every close); whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session.
